chapter: Playing bass in the early bands
title: Playing full chords on the bass
summary: Dissatisfied with two beats to the bar, he played full chords on the bass to fill out the band; also notes on tailgate trombone.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
